---
format:
  typst:
    font-paths: resources/fonts
execute:
  warning: false
  echo: false
  message: false
  eval: true
---

```{=typst}
// === PAGE ===
#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  fill: rgb("#F8F7F0"),
  margin: (top: 0.3in, bottom: 0.6in, left: 0.6in, right: 0.6in),
  footer: context {
    set text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#666"), style: "italic")
    let updated = datetime.today().display(
      "Updated [month repr:long] [day padding:none], [year]"
    )
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
      align(left)[#updated],
      align(center)[Page #counter(page).display() of #counter(page).final().last()],
      align(right)[#link("https://pingfan.org")[pingfan.org]],
    )
  },
)

#set text(font: ("Optima", "Helvetica Neue", "Arial"), size: 10pt)
#set par(leading: 0.5em, justify: false, spacing: 0pt)
#set block(spacing: 0pt)

// === SPACING KNOBS ===
// `gap` controls every major boundary (above sections, below section rules,
// between lists/tables/entries). Tune this one value to tighten or loosen
// the whole resume. `entry-gap` is the tighter gap from an entry title to
// its first bullet.
#let gap = 5pt
#let entry-gap = 2pt

// === LISTS & TABLES ===
#show list: set block(spacing: 0.25em)
#show list: set par(leading: 0.35em)
#set list(indent: 1em, body-indent: 0.4em, marker: ([•]))

// Lists/tables emit `gap` AFTER themselves so the gap to the next block is
// always `gap`. Tables also get a small lead-in for breathing room.
#show list: it => { it; v(gap) }
#show table: it => { v(3pt); it; v(gap) }

// Navy-blue links
#show link: set text(fill: rgb(0%, 20%, 60%))

// Monospace font for inline code spans
#show raw: set text(font: "Maple Mono NF", size: 0.92em)

// === LUCIDE ICONS ===
#let li(code) = box(baseline: 0.2em)[#text(font: "lucide", size: 9pt, code)]
#let liMapPin = li("\u{E111}")
#let liMail = li("\u{E10F}")
#let liPhone = li("\u{E133}")
#let liCompass = li("\u{E09B}")

// === HELPERS ===
// Section header with underline rule.
#let section(name) = {
  text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold")[#upper[#name]]
  v(4pt)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#888"))
  v(gap)
}

// Project/general entry — title left, dates right.
#let entry(title, dates) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: (left, right),
    title, text(weight: "regular")[#dates],
  )
  v(entry-gap)
}

// Work entry — fixed-width left column so locations line up across rows.
#let work-entry(company-role, location, dates) = {
  grid(
    columns: (50%, 1fr, auto),
    align: (left, left, right),
    company-role,
    text(weight: "regular")[#location],
    text(weight: "regular")[#dates],
  )
  v(entry-gap)
}

// === HEADER ===
#align(center)[
  #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold")[Pingfan Hu]
]

#v(6pt)

#align(center)[
  #text(size: 9pt)[
    #liMapPin~Greater Melbourne, Australia
    ~|~
    #liMail~#link("mailto:pingfanhu@proton.me")[pingfanhu\@proton.me]
    ~|~
    #liPhone~+61 431 251 227
    ~|~
    #liCompass~#link("https://pingfan.org")[pingfan.org]
  ]
]

#v(5pt)

#section[Education]

#align(center)[
  #table(
    columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto),
    stroke: none,
    inset: (x: 0pt, y: 2pt),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    align: left,
    [2026], [*George Washington University*], [Ph.D.], [Systems Engineering], [GPA 4.0],
    [2018], [*University of Sydney*], [M.P.E.], [Mechanical Engineering], [GPA 3.5],
    [2015], [*Pennsylvania State University*], [B.S.], [Industrial Engineering], [GPA 3.2],
  )
]

#section[Skills]
```
